notes.title: Translated to 4 more languages!
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy ya'll!

This update is going to bring on more languages to all you lovely cow herders!
We've now got the game in Welsh, Swedish, Norwegian and Chinese!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949480/936c6c1fbfec1c49c4a502dba040cdd2e583e62b.jpg[/img]

It was fun trying out translations for the game, so hopefully you can enjoy the game in the limited languages we have it in!![/b]
